LanguageData.LP_OB_DreadfulAspect.label: channel oath: dreadful aspect
LanguageData.LP_OB_DreadfulAspect.description: Reveal your dark true face: enemies within radius 6 (except mechanoids) have a 60% chance to be shaken and flee for 10 seconds (-5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%). Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oathbreaker, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_OB_ControlUndead.label: channel oath: control undead
LanguageData.LP_OB_ControlUndead.description: Turn a hostile undead or fiend within 15 cells (liches, necromantic constructs, shamblers and other mutants, death knights, demiliches, creatures of the Abyss and the Nine Hells) to your side: 80% success (-5% per level the target is above you, minimum 10%); on success it joins your faction for 1 day, after which it most likely breaks free, with a 30% chance it chooses to stay. Story bosses and legendary units are unaffected. Channel Oath 1, no divinity cost. Oathbreaker, paladin level 3.
LanguageData.LP_OB_AuraOfHate.label: aura of hate
LanguageData.LP_OB_AuraOfHate.description: Passive: you and undead and fiends of your side within radius 5 get melee damage ×(1.1 + Charisma modifier × 0.02) (negative Charisma modifier counts as 0). Auras of several Oathbreakers don't stack; the strongest applies. Oathbreaker, paladin level 7.
LanguageData.LP_OB_SupernaturalResistance.label: supernatural resistance
LanguageData.LP_OB_SupernaturalResistance.description: Passive: sharp and blunt damage taken (swords, blunt weapons, bullets, arrows, etc.) ×0.75; holy damage and silver weapons aren't reduced by this. Oathbreaker, paladin level 11.
LanguageData.LP_OB_DreadLord.label: dread lord
LanguageData.LP_OB_DreadLord.description: Become a Dread Lord for 60 seconds: casting first releases a Dreadful Aspect in radius 6 (no Channel Oath cost); then every 4 seconds enemies within radius 6 (excluding downed ones) take 6 × divine power necrotic damage, and you take ×0.5 ranged damage. No divinity cost, once per day. Oathbreaker, paladin level 15.
